effect = [[Improved archery]] * [[Bows (skill)|Bows]] +15 | resistance = *Weak (1.5x) vs [[Fire]] }} }} The '''Root Set''' is a [[Swamp]]-tier [[armor]]. This set is in the tier above [[Bronze Armor]] and the [[Troll Set]]. It provides less [[Damage_mechanics#Armor|armor points]], but also a lower movement speed penalty compared to the other swamp-tier armor, [[Iron Armor]]. Each piece provides weakness to fire, but individual parts give resistance to pierce (in the harnesk) and poison (in the mask). Its unique set bonus increases the wearer's Bow skill by 15 levels ''(see: [[Improved archery]])''. The 50% [[Damage#Poison|poison]] resistance from the mask makes this armor very useful in the [[Swamp]], where there are many poison-inflicting enemies. Furthermore, the resistance against [[Damage#Pierce|pierce damage]] is useful against enemies in the [[Plains]] and [[Mistlands]], many of which have pierce damage attacks. However, [[Fire Resistance Barley Wine|Barley Wine]] is strongly encouraged to counter the fire weakness received from any piece of the armor. == Armor pieces == This set of armor has three pieces which are crafted and upgraded at the [[Workbench]]. 1= === Quality 1 === Workbench level: 2
